name: 张千羽
tagline: AI 产品经理，关注 Agent 工作流、模型评测与业务增长。做过内容创作工具和海外产品，也为企业交付 AI 应用；把需求做成能用的产品，再用数据验证效果。
taglineEn: AI product manager working on Agent workflows, model evaluation and growth. I build content-creation tools, work on overseas products and deliver AI applications for businesses, then use data to test what works.

education.school: 伦敦大学学院 (University College London)

thesis.title: 基于订单流的标普 500 日内交易模型
thesis.titleEn: Order-Flow-Based Intraday Trading for the S&P 500
thesis.summary: 以订单流（Order Flow）为核心研究输入，构建标普 500 相关市场的日内量化交易模型，探索订单流信息在短周期交易决策中的应用。
thesis.summaryEn: Developed an intraday quantitative trading model for S&P 500-related markets, exploring how order-flow information can inform short-horizon trading decisions.

education.school: 布里斯托大学 (University of Bristol)
education.degree: 电子电气工程 · 本科

thesis.title: 面向运动场景的可穿戴姿态监测系统
thesis.summary: 面向健身等运动场景，设计人体工学可穿戴设备，利用机器学习分析多个设备的信号变化进行姿态监测，并配套手机端交互。
thesis.summaryEn: Designed ergonomic wearables for fitness and other exercise settings, using machine learning to analyze signals from multiple devices for posture monitoring, alongside a mobile interface.

experience.location: AI 内容创作与海外业务
highlights: 负责国内、海外双线 11 类创作能力，设计六阶段对话式 Agent 与可插拔 Skill；上线 38 个 Skill，单剧创作耗时缩短约 30%，工具月均调用 6000 次、编剧使用覆盖率 70%。
推动剧本拆解、资产生产与分镜生成链路化，定义角色一致性、风格统一及描述遵循度等评测口径；内测样本中单集制作耗时缩短约 30%。
负责一键视频转绘的需求定义、流程与上线迭代；初步估算人工处理耗时缩短约 20%，生成镜头可用率提升约 1 倍。
基于 Q2 海外收入下滑 11% 的归因分析设计订阅试点；试点月复购率提升约 20%，ARPU 提升 8%，订阅用户占比由 18% 提升至 35%。
highlightsEn: Owned 11 creation capabilities across domestic and overseas products. Designed a six-stage conversational Agent and pluggable Skills: 38 Skills shipped, about 30% less creation time per title, 6,000 monthly tool calls and 70% screenwriter usage coverage.

Connected script breakdown, asset production and storyboard generation. Defined evaluation criteria for character consistency, style and description adherence; internal trial samples showed about 30% less production time per episode.
Defined and iterated one-click video restyling. Preliminary estimates showed about 20% less manual processing time and roughly twice the usable-shot rate.
Diagnosed an 11% Q2 overseas revenue decline and designed a subscription pilot. Pilot monthly repeat purchase rose about 20%, ARPU 8%, and subscriber share from 18% to 35%.

works.name: 创作 Agent 与 Skill 资产
works.desc: 把拆解、提案、策划、MVP、全本、导出组织成可对话的主链路，在开放创作环节结合 ReAct 工具调用与 Agent 交叉校验，并保留人工确认。将 SOP、Prompt、知识与工具配置封装为 38 个 Skill，建立版本、效果对比和反馈机制。单剧创作耗时缩短约 30%。
works.descEn: Designed a conversational flow from breakdown through proposal, planning, MVP, full draft and export. Used ReAct tool calls and Agent cross-checks in open-ended creation stages, with human checkpoints. Packaged SOPs, prompts, knowledge and tools into 38 Skills with versioning, output comparison and feedback; creation time per title fell about 30%.

works.name: AIGC 制作链路与质量评测
works.desc: 区分项目全局提示词与镜头配置，把角色、场景和道具组织为可复用资产，支持跨项目引用与分镜一键关联。结合人工评审和 Bad Case 归因迭代资产引用、提示词与生成配置；内测样本中单集制作耗时缩短约 30%。
works.descEn: Separated project-wide prompts from shot configurations and made characters, scenes and props reusable across projects. Used human reviews and failure-case analysis to iterate asset references, prompts and generation settings; internal trial samples showed about 30% less production time per episode.

works.name: 一键视频转绘
works.desc: 串联原片上传、角色与场景解析、目标画风转换及分镜视频生成，围绕角色辨识度、画风一致性和节奏保留迭代。初步估算人工处理耗时缩短约 20%，生成镜头可用率提升约 1 倍。
works.descEn: Connected upload, character and scene parsing, target-style conversion and shot generation. Iterated recognisability, style consistency and preservation of pacing. Preliminary estimates showed about 20% less manual processing time and roughly twice the usable-shot rate.

works.name: 海外订阅试点
works.desc: 将收入拆为活跃用户、付费转化、付费频次与客单价，识别首购后持续付费不足。选择北美试点，设计包月档位与前三集免费组合，通过 A/B Test 验证后分阶段放大；试点月复购率提升约 20%，ARPU 提升 8%，订阅用户占比由 18% 提升至 35%。
works.descEn: Decomposed revenue into active users, paid conversion, purchase frequency and order value, identifying weak repeat payment after first purchase. Piloted monthly tiers with the first three episodes free in North America, then scaled in stages after A/B tests. Pilot monthly repeat purchase rose about 20%, ARPU 8%, and subscriber share from 18% to 35%.

highlights: 负责 AI 命理功能 0→1，结合 GenFlow 个性化生成与 AI 壁纸玩法；上线两周日活破万，周回访率 35%，带动文库会员转化提升约 8%。
用埋点与 SQL 定位深层 Tab 导致曝光折损超 70%，推动主动弹窗与路径优化；弹窗拉动单日 UV 增长 10 倍，迭代后留存 UV 提升约 60%，分享率 26%。
重构知识库信息架构，落地多级文件夹并协同检索、渲染和模型上下文策略；知识库周均访问次数提升约 30%，AI 问答使用率提升约 25%。
highlightsEn: Launched AI fortune features from 0 to 1 with GenFlow personalisation and AI wallpapers. DAU exceeded 10,000 within two weeks, weekly return rate reached 35%, and Wenku membership conversion rose about 8%.

Used event tracking and SQL to locate over 70% exposure loss through deep tabs. Improved pop-up discovery and navigation: single-day UV increased tenfold, post-iteration retained UV rose about 60%, and sharing reached 26%.
Restructured the knowledge base with multi-level folders and coordinated retrieval, rendering and model-context changes. Weekly visits rose about 30% and AI Q&A usage about 25%.

works.name: AI 命理馆与玩法复制
works.desc: 定义每日运势、许愿抽签和八字、星盘等多维测算，依托 GenFlow 生成个性化报告，并将运势转化为可传播的 AI 壁纸。上线两周日活破万、周回访率 35%；模式复制至 AI 百宝箱的六款人格测试，新品上线周期缩短约 40%。
works.descEn: Defined daily fortunes, wish draws and multidimensional readings using GenFlow-generated personalised reports and shareable AI wallpapers. DAU exceeded 10,000 within two weeks and weekly return rate reached 35%. Reused the approach in six personality experiences, shortening new-product launch cycles about 40%.

works.name: 曝光归因与主动触达
works.desc: 用 SQL 拆用户行为路径，识别深层 Tab 导致曝光折损超 70%。面向高活跃用户在首页与 Tab 页主动推荐入口，并优化路径引导；主动弹窗拉动单日 UV 增长 10 倍，迭代后留存 UV 提升约 60%，分享率 26%。
works.descEn: Analysed user paths in SQL and identified over 70% exposure loss through deep tabs. Added proactive entry points on the home and tab pages for active users and simplified navigation. Pop-ups drove a tenfold single-day UV increase; retained UV rose about 60% after iteration, with 26% sharing.

works.name: 知识库与 AI 问答
works.desc: 重构文库 App 知识库的信息架构，落地多级文件夹，协同优化检索、前端渲染与 GenFlow 上下文分配，串联资料管理、内容检索和 AI 问答。知识库周均访问次数提升约 30%，AI 问答使用率提升约 25%。
works.descEn: Restructured Wenku’s knowledge base with multi-level folders and coordinated retrieval, rendering and GenFlow context allocation. Connected document management, retrieval and AI Q&A; weekly visits rose about 30% and AI Q&A usage about 25%.

experience.role: 用户增长产品经理实习生
highlights: 识别 3 人以上家庭聚餐需求占比 35% 与单人餐供给的错位，设计家庭套餐专区与多人份推荐；家庭套餐订单占比达到 22%，套餐客单价高于平台订单均值约 45%。
按城市阶段、留存与价格敏感度分层调整补贴，通过 A/B Test 比较获客及后续留存；新客获客成本降低 27%，新客月留存提升 8%。
highlightsEn: Identified a mismatch between 35% demand for meals for three or more people and single-person supply. Designed family bundles and recommendations; bundles reached 22% of orders, with order value about 45% above the platform average.

Segmented subsidies by city stage, retention and price sensitivity, using A/B tests to compare acquisition and subsequent retention. New-customer acquisition cost fell 27% and new-customer monthly retention rose 8%.

works.name: 家庭聚餐场景与商品供给
works.desc: 从订单结构与流失路径识别家庭聚餐需求，联动商家补充多人份组合，并设计专区、商品规格和推荐策略。家庭套餐订单占比达到 22%，该类套餐客单价高于平台订单均值约 45%。
works.descEn: Used order composition and drop-off paths to identify family dining demand, coordinated multi-person supply and designed the collection, specifications and recommendations. Family bundles reached 22% of orders and their order value was about 45% above the platform average.

works.name: 补贴效率与留存验证
works.desc: 识别高补贴、低留存人群，差异化调整优惠券门槛、力度与覆盖范围，用 A/B Test 同时观察短期转化和后续留存。新客获客成本降低 27%，新客月留存提升 8%。
works.descEn: Identified high-subsidy, low-retention segments, varied coupon thresholds, amounts and coverage, and used A/B tests to examine short-term conversion alongside subsequent retention. New-customer acquisition cost fell 27% and monthly retention rose 8%.

experience.company: 理想汽车 · 智能座舱
highlights: 结合埋点与 20+ 场门店走访，定义一键联动座椅、遮阳帘、空调、氛围灯和白噪音的“小憩模式”，支持自然语言泛化指令。
通过 A/B Test 确定 App 与车机双入口；上线后午休时段渗透率从 10% 提升至 30%，单次沉浸时长翻倍，语音唤醒占比 40%，功能 NPS 位列座舱场景类前三。
highlightsEn: Combined event data with 20+ store visits to define a rest mode linking seats, blinds, climate, lighting and white noise, with natural-language activation.

Used A/B tests to confirm app and in-car entry points. After launch, lunchtime penetration rose from 10% to 30%, session duration doubled, voice activation reached 40%, and NPS ranked in the top three cockpit scenarios.

works.name: 从午休痛点到软硬件联动
works.nameEn: From Rest Needs to Integrated Controls
works.desc: 识别午休需要手动调节 5—6 步、平均耗时超一分钟的问题，撰写 PRD 并打通座椅、遮阳帘、空调、氛围灯和白噪音。引入大模型意图识别，支持“我有点困了”等表达；上线后午休时段渗透率从 10% 提升至 30%。
works.descEn: Found that preparing for a lunchtime rest required five or six manual steps and over a minute. Defined the PRD and integrated seats, blinds, climate, lighting and white noise with model-based intent recognition. Lunchtime penetration rose from 10% to 30% after launch.

experience.role: 产品实习生（增长与商业化）
highlights: 参与 Premium 会员增长实验，围绕汇率优惠、消费返现等权益优化展示和升级引导，通过 A/B Test 验证方案，订阅转化率提升超 15%。
基于大模型纠错数据梳理智能预算功能的高频交互问题，推动预算信息呈现与操作引导优化，模块点击率提升超 20%。
highlightsEn: Contributed to Premium growth experiments, improving benefit presentation and upgrade prompts around exchange-rate and cashback benefits. A/B-tested changes lifted subscription conversion over 15%.
Used model-correction data to identify frequent smart-budget interaction problems and improve information presentation and guidance. Module click-through rose over 20%.

works.name: Premium 权益与升级引导
works.desc: 结合用户使用场景与触达时机优化权益展示和升级引导，通过 A/B Test 比较方案，订阅转化率提升超 15%。
works.descEn: Improved benefit presentation and upgrade guidance around users’ needs and timing. Compared approaches through A/B tests; subscription conversion rose over 15%.

works.name: 智能预算交互迭代
works.desc: 将大模型纠错数据中的高频问题转为产品需求，协同研发完善预算信息呈现与操作引导，模块点击率提升超 20%。
works.descEn: Turned recurring model-correction issues into product requirements and worked with engineering on budget information and guidance. Module click-through rose over 20%.

projects.name: 有据 · 生活决策审议台
projects.subtitle: 从经验材料到可追溯的生活决策
projects.subtitleEn: From collected experience to traceable decisions
projects.description: 识别经验中的共识、分歧与适用条件，结合个人约束比较方案，由用户选择并导出决策卡。
projects.descriptionEn: Compare options against personal constraints using consensus, disagreement and applicability from collected experiences; the user chooses and exports a decision card.
projects.context: 经验很多，但哪些适合自己、相反意见如何权衡，往往不清楚。
projects.contextEn: Collected experiences do not make it clear which advice fits or how conflicting views should be weighed.
approach: 区分硬约束、偏好与待核实信息，明确标出方案冲突
保留材料依据、反方意见与行动前核实清单
approachEn: Separate hard constraints, preferences and unknowns; flag conflicting options.
Keep supporting material, opposing views and a pre-action verification checklist.
projects.result: 川西旅行与养猫家庭扫地机器人双场景 Demo；使用原创模拟资料，不接入实时搜索或电商价格。
projects.resultEn: Two demos: Western Sichuan travel and robot vacuums for cat-owning households. Uses original simulated material, not live search or e-commerce prices.
projects.demoNote: 先在首页选场景；推荐从未替用户自动做决定。扫地机器人场景的评论是演示样本，比价价格需手动输入。
projects.demoNoteEn: Choose either scenario on the homepage. Recommendations never make the final choice for the user. Product comments are simulated and comparison prices are entered manually.

projects.name: LLM 效果评估体系（creative-eval）
projects.description: 用评分锚点评估剧本质量，再以人工金标与重复评分检查裁判的一致性和稳定性。
projects.descriptionEn: Score scripts against anchored criteria, then check judge agreement and stability using human-labeled references and repeated runs.
projects.subtitle: 短剧剧本的五维评分与裁判校验
projects.subtitleEn: Five-dimension script scoring and judge validation
projects.context: 主观评审难以复现，也难以比较不同版本。
projects.contextEn: Subjective reviews are hard to reproduce or use for version comparison.
approach: 为钩子、人物动机、冲突、节奏与爽点设置评分锚点
用人工金标和三次重复评分，分别检查一致性与稳定性
approachEn: Anchor scores for hook, motivation, conflict, pacing and payoff.
Check agreement against human labels and stability across three repeated runs.
projects.result: 第一版评测体系；用于辅助筛选与版本比较，不替代人工终审。Demo 展示第二版 llm-output-eval。
projects.resultEn: The first evaluation framework supports screening and version comparison, not final human review. The demo presents its successor, llm-output-eval.
projects.demoNote: Demo 以第二版 llm-output-eval 呈现

projects.name: llm-output-eval
projects.subtitle: 有原文证据的长文本评测与版本对比
projects.subtitleEn: Evidence-backed text evaluation and version comparison
projects.description: 逐维评分并附原文证据，重复评测比较 Prompt 版本，将低分案例导出为 CSV。自带 API Key，可运行真实评测。
projects.descriptionEn: Score each dimension with source-text evidence, compare prompt versions across repeated runs, and export low-scoring cases to CSV. Bring an API key to run live evaluations.
projects.context: 需要比较生成版本的质量，同时确认打分器本身可靠。
projects.contextEn: Version comparison requires both useful quality scores and a calibrated judge.
approach: 每个分数附原文证据，并用人工金标校验裁判
重复运行两版 Prompt，比较均值与波动，汇总低分案例
approachEn: Attach source-text evidence and calibrate the judge against human labels.
Run both prompt versions repeatedly, compare averages and variation, and collect low-scoring cases.
projects.result: 适合辅助质量排序与版本比较；单次整数评分仍存在波动。API Key 仅保存在浏览器。
projects.resultEn: Supports quality ranking and version comparison; individual integer scores still vary. API keys remain in the browser.

projects.name: LLM 效果评估体系（filing-eval）
projects.description: 将摘要拆成原子断言，回原文核查支持、矛盾或无依据，并测试误报与提示注入。
projects.descriptionEn: Split summaries into atomic claims, check whether the source supports, contradicts or leaves them ungrounded, and test false positives and prompt injection.
projects.subtitle: 逐条核查公告摘要的事实依据
projects.subtitleEn: Claim-level fact checking for filing summaries
projects.context: 公告摘要可能添加原文没有的数字或因果关系。
projects.contextEn: Filing summaries can add numbers or causal claims absent from the source.
approach: 逐条断言回溯原文证据
用错误、正确与注入样本检查检出能力和误报
approachEn: Trace each claim to source evidence.
Test detection and false positives using erroneous, correct and injected samples.
projects.result: 样本集检出 11/11，误报 0/4，注入防护 5/5；结果仅对应当前测试样本。
projects.resultEn: On the test set: 11/11 errors detected, 0/4 false positives and 5/5 injection defenses passed. Results apply to these samples only.

projects.name: 百度文库命理馆
projects.description: 定义 AI 命理与分享玩法，用埋点和 SQL 改善发现路径，将验证后的产品模式复制到人格测试。
projects.descriptionEn: Designed AI fortune and sharing experiences, improved discovery with event data and SQL, and reused the validated approach in personality tests.
metrics: 上线两周 DAU 破万
projects.subtitle: 高频互动与结果分享的 AI 产品
projects.subtitleEn: An AI product for recurring interaction and sharing
projects.context: 为文库提供兼顾深度体验与日常回访的轻互动场景。
projects.contextEn: Provide lightweight interaction that supports both deeper sessions and recurring visits.
approach: 通过 GenFlow 个性化生成报告，并将结果转化为可传播的 AI 壁纸
定位深层 Tab 导致曝光折损超 70%，通过主动触达优化访问路径
approachEn: Generated personalised GenFlow reports and shareable AI wallpapers.
Identified over 70% exposure loss through deep tabs and improved discovery with proactive entry points.
projects.result: 上线两周日活破万，周回访率 35%，文库会员转化提升约 8%；主动触达迭代后留存 UV 提升约 60%，分享率 26%。
projects.resultEn: DAU exceeded 10,000 within two weeks, weekly return rate reached 35%, and membership conversion rose about 8%. After discovery iteration, retained UV rose about 60%, with 26% sharing.

projects.name: AI 定制壁纸玩法
projects.description: 结合 GenFlow AIGC 图像能力，把抽象运势转化为个性化、可保存和可传播的视觉内容。
projects.descriptionEn: Used GenFlow AIGC image capabilities to turn fortune outputs into personalised, saveable and shareable visual content.
projects.subtitle: 把运势结果转化为个性化壁纸
projects.subtitleEn: Turn fortune results into personalized wallpapers
projects.context: 结果页缺少可保存、持续使用的内容载体。
projects.contextEn: Result pages lack a format users can save and keep using.
approach: 把生成结果转为用户可以带走的壁纸，衔接命理报告与视觉表达
结合用户反馈迭代内容呈现，与命理馆主流程一起验证
approachEn: Turned generated results into wallpapers users can keep, connecting reports with visual expression.
Iterated presentation from feedback and evaluated it within the broader fortune experience.
projects.result: 壁纸为命理馆整体玩法的一部分；简历中的回访与会员转化结果属于整体产品，不单独归因为壁纸。
projects.resultEn: Wallpapers formed part of the overall fortune experience. Return-visit and membership results describe the combined product, not an isolated wallpaper effect.

projects.name: 企业 AI 应用与轻量业务工具（FDE）
projects.subtitle: 把 AI 接入实际业务流程
projects.description: 为选品、知识问答、线索跟进和制造业 ERP/CRM 交付可操作工具，保留来源核验与关键人工确认。
projects.descriptionEn: Delivered tools for product selection, knowledge Q&A, lead follow-up and manufacturing ERP/CRM, with source checks and human confirmation.
projects.role: 企业 AI 应用实践
projects.context: 商家的信息收集、知识回复和业务记录分散，人工整理多，关键动态信息仍需要确认。
projects.contextEn: Research, knowledge replies and business records were fragmented, with repetitive manual organisation and changing facts requiring confirmation.
approach: 选品与测款：组织社媒及电商信息，支持同款识别、竞品比较和小规模测试，交付带实图、来源和核验状态的看板与 Skill
知识库与客服：整理商品资料和问答，支持回复草稿、来源查询与人工接管
获客与线索：设计筛选、个性化触达和跟进记录，关键价格与交付条件交由人工确认
ERP/CRM：梳理扫码出入库、库存盘点、生产状态与线索记录，将日常记录、盘点核对和汇总拆为独立模块
approachEn: Selection and testing: combined social and commerce information for product matching, comparison and small tests, with images, sources, verification status and reusable Skills.
Knowledge and service: organised product information for reply drafts, source lookup and human takeover.
Leads: designed screening, personalised contact and records, with human confirmation for pricing and delivery commitments.
ERP/CRM: organised scanning, inventory, production and leads into separate recording, reconciliation and reporting modules.
projects.result: 工具辅助下，选品信息搜集与整理人工耗时减少约 40%；制造业工具的生产与库存信息汇总耗时降低约 20%。
projects.resultEn: Tool-assisted selection research and organisation took about 40% less manual time; production and inventory reporting time fell about 20%. These measure separate delivery modules.

projects.name: 个人智能投研 Agent 与量化研究工具
projects.nameEn: Personal Investment Research Agent & Quant Tools
projects.subtitle: 从多源信息到可回查的研究记录
projects.subtitleEn: From multiple sources to traceable research records
projects.description: 组织财报、新闻与情绪分析任务，生成盘后研究日报；另建量化研究看板，检查信号、风险与样本外表现。
projects.descriptionEn: Orchestrated filings, news and sentiment tasks into daily research reports, with a separate dashboard for signals, risk and out-of-sample analysis.
metrics: 每日信息提炼：约 2 小时 → 20 分钟
projects.context: 个人投研存在信息过载与重复搜集，需要将资料获取、研究摘要和盘后复盘组织为可追溯任务。
projects.contextEn: Personal research involved information overload and repeated gathering, requiring traceable tasks from information collection to post-market review.
approach: 组织多源获取、内容结构化、情绪分析、研究摘要和盘后复盘，对接 IBKR API 及外部信息源
另建趋势、波动率与相对强弱研究模块，展示事件概率、20 日预期收益、下行风险、退出评分及主要多空因素
将策略与买入持有、均线退出、ATR 移动止损进行样本外对照，纳入交易成本与时间序列防泄漏设计
approachEn: Connected IBKR and external sources across gathering, structuring, sentiment, summary and post-market review tasks.
Built a separate module for trend, volatility and relative strength, showing event probabilities, 20-day expected returns, downside risk, exit scores and key factors.
Compared strategies out of sample with buy-and-hold, moving-average exits and ATR trailing stops, accounting for costs and temporal leakage.
projects.result: 每日投研信息获取与提炼耗时由约 2 小时缩短至 20 分钟；量化研究模块纳入交易成本与时间序列隔离，支持历史表现与适用边界检查。
projects.resultEn: Daily information gathering and synthesis fell from about two hours to twenty minutes. The quantitative research module accounts for trading costs and temporal separation to examine historical behaviour and applicability.

projects.name: 通勤方案比较器（commute-compare）
projects.subtitle: 比较通勤成本、耗时与迟到风险
projects.subtitleEn: Compare commute cost, duration and lateness risk
projects.description: 输入各方案的最快、常见、最慢耗时及费用，用模拟比较月度成本与迟到概率，计算满足风险偏好的出门时间。
projects.descriptionEn: Enter best, typical and worst travel times plus cost; simulations compare monthly cost and lateness risk and calculate a departure time for your risk tolerance.
metrics: 杭州地铁：08:32 出门，迟到 3.53%
打车月省 7.5 小时，却要更早出门
metricsEn: Taxi saves 7.5h/month but needs an earlier start

projects.name: 德州扑克玩家类型测试
projects.description: 通过入池率、激进度与粘性识别玩家风格；专业与简单双模式，兼顾有经验玩家和新手。
projects.descriptionEn: Identify player style through VPIP, aggression and stickiness, with professional and simple modes for experienced players and beginners.
projects.subtitle: 用十道题识别自己的扑克风格
projects.subtitleEn: Ten questions to identify your poker style
projects.context: 新手难以描述自己的打法，专业术语又提高了测试门槛。
projects.contextEn: Beginners struggle to describe their style, while specialist terms raise the entry barrier.
approach: 用三个行为维度组织十道题
提供专业与简单双模式，降低术语门槛
approachEn: Organize ten questions around three behavioral dimensions.
Offer professional and simple modes to reduce jargon barriers.
projects.result: 已上线，可直接完成测试并查看风格结果。
projects.resultEn: Live: complete the quiz and view a style profile.

projects.name: 扑克筹码管理模拟器（poker-bankroll-sim）
projects.subtitle: 模拟资金路径，评估破产与回撤风险
projects.subtitleEn: Simulate bankroll paths and assess downside risk
projects.description: 输入资金、买入、胜率与方差，模拟资金路径、破产概率和最大回撤；用解析解交叉检查模拟结果。
projects.descriptionEn: Enter bankroll, buy-in, win rate and variance to simulate bankroll paths, bust probability and drawdown; cross-check the simulation against an analytical solution.

projects.name: 扑克期望值计算器（poker-ev-calculator）
projects.subtitle: 比较弃牌、跟注与加注的期望收益
projects.subtitleEn: Compare the expected value of folding, calling and raising
projects.description: 结合手牌强度与对手行为比较三种行动的 EV；加注按被跟注后的胜率修正，并用敏感性分析找出决策切换点。
projects.descriptionEn: Compare action EVs using hand strength and opponent behavior; adjust raise EV for equity after being called and use sensitivity analysis to locate decision thresholds.
metrics: AA 加注 EV +42.50 最优
平衡强度 50：高于它加注都成立
metricsEn: AA raise EV +42.50, the best line

projects.name: Growth Experiment Lab
projects.subtitle: 从实验设计到结果解读的决策工具
projects.subtitleEn: A decision tool from experiment design to interpretation
projects.description: 计算 A/B 实验样本量，模拟提前停止带来的误判，并将结果区间折算为增量收入。全部计算在浏览器完成。
projects.descriptionEn: Calculate A/B test sample sizes, simulate errors from early stopping, and translate result intervals into incremental revenue. All calculations run in the browser.
projects.context: 实验前要确定样本量，实验中要控制误判，实验后要解释收益。
projects.contextEn: Determine sample size before a test, control errors during it, and interpret business value afterward.
approach: 计算样本量与实验时长，模拟不同检查策略的假阳性风险
输出置信区间，并折算保守与乐观的增量收入
approachEn: Calculate sample size and duration; simulate false-positive risk under different checking strategies.
Report confidence intervals and translate them into conservative and optimistic revenue estimates.
projects.result: 本地运行的实验决策 Demo，不上传数据；模拟结果用于说明统计风险，不代表业务实验收益。
projects.resultEn: A local experiment-decision demo that uploads no data. Simulation results illustrate statistical risk, not business experiment returns.

projects.name: Pricing Model Sim
projects.subtitle: 比较三种付费机制的 LTV 与回本周期
projects.subtitleEn: Compare LTV and payback across three pricing mechanisms
projects.description: 调整留存与价格，比较单次解锁、订阅和混合机制的 12 个月收益，并通过敏感性分析找出机制切换点。
projects.descriptionEn: Adjust retention and pricing to compare 12-month returns from pay-per-unlock, subscription and hybrid models; use sensitivity analysis to identify switch-over points.
projects.context: 不同付费机制的收益取决于留存、转化与价格，不能只比较收入总额。
projects.contextEn: Mechanism returns depend on retention, conversion and price, not just total revenue.
approach: 用同一留存曲线比较三种机制的 LTV 与回本周期
扫描价格、转化等参数，找出最优机制变化的条件
approachEn: Compare LTV and payback across three mechanisms using one retention curve.
Sweep pricing and conversion parameters to find where the preferred mechanism changes.
projects.result: 提供四个合成案例与校验脚本；用于机制比较，不接入真实业务数据。
projects.resultEn: Includes four synthetic cases and validation scripts; compares mechanisms without connecting to real business data.

projects.name: Bundle Lab
projects.subtitle: 从订单共现中发现套餐机会
projects.subtitleEn: Discover bundle opportunities from co-purchased items
projects.description: 从订单中识别常购组合，模拟折扣与采纳率对客单和毛利的影响，导出套餐建议及收益边界。
projects.descriptionEn: Identify frequently co-purchased items, simulate how discount and adoption affect basket size and margin, and export bundle recommendations and profit boundaries.
projects.context: 商品经常一起购买，不等于组合成套餐后一定赚钱。
projects.contextEn: Frequently co-purchased items are not necessarily profitable as a discounted bundle.
approach: 对比订单结构，发现共购组合并进行召回校验
模拟折扣与采纳率，计算毛利变化和盈亏平衡点
approachEn: Compare order profiles, discover co-purchased combinations and check recall.
Simulate discount and adoption to calculate margin changes and break-even points.
projects.result: 浏览器端分析工具，使用合成数据演示；不接平台 API，不做在线推荐或库存管理。
projects.resultEn: A browser-based analysis tool demonstrated with synthetic data; no platform API, live recommendation or inventory management.

projects.name: 留学咨询内容矩阵
projects.description: 基于真人案例和垂类账号建立内容获客链路，贯通公域内容、私域咨询与线索跟进。
projects.descriptionEn: Built acquisition around first-hand stories and focused accounts, connecting public content, private consultation and lead follow-up.

principles.dz: 多数做不下去的需求，是因为一开始没说清要解决什么。我习惯先把问题写成一句话，写不出来就说明还没想明白。
principles.de: Most stalled requests were never clearly stated. I write the problem as one sentence first; if I cannot, it is not ready.

principles.en: A metric needs a failure condition
principles.dz: 定指标的时候同时定清楚：什么情况算没达到。没有失败条件的指标只是装饰。
principles.de: When setting a metric, also define what counts as missing it. A metric without a failure condition is decoration.

principles.en: Do it yourself when you can
principles.dz: 写需求之前先把流程亲自走一遍。走一遍才知道哪一步是多余的、哪一句话会被理解错。
principles.de: Before writing a spec, walk the flow myself. Only then do I find which step is redundant and which sentence will be misread.

about.body3: 我喜欢先把想法做成能操作的版本，让用户用起来，再看反馈和数据。能否进入真实工作、哪些结果可以验证，是我判断一个 AI 产品是否有用的起点。
about.body3En: I like making an idea usable, putting it in front of people and examining their feedback and the data. Whether it fits real work, and which outcomes can be verified, is where I start judging an AI product.

items.name: Metabase / GA / 埋点
items.zh: 明确事件和指标口径，观察关键路径与实验结果，把异常带回复盘。
items.en: Define events and metrics, monitor key journeys and experiment results, and investigate anomalies.
Capability is abundant, judgement is scarce
items.dz: 模型能做的事已经远多于产品里用上的事。今天多数 AI 产品的瓶颈不在模型，在有没有人把它放进一个真实场景，定义清楚它要解决的具体问题。这是产品的活，不是算法的活。
items.de: Models can already do far more than products make use of. The bottleneck in most AI products today is not the model. It is whether someone has placed it in a real scenario and defined the specific problem it must solve. That is product work, not algorithm work.
items.refLabel: YouTube · Andrej Karpathy, Software in the Era of AI (2025)

items.dz: 一个 AI 功能「好不好」，不能靠感觉。我倾向于先把评测标准建出来再谈效果。标准本身就是产品的一部分，它决定了团队朝哪个方向优化，也决定了上线之后谁来说「够了」。
items.de: Whether an AI feature is "good" cannot rest on feel. I prefer to build the evaluation standard before discussing results. The standard is part of the product: it decides which direction the team optimises toward, and who gets to say "enough" after launch.

items.zh: 接下来十年是 Agent 的十年，不是 Agent 的一年
items.en: The decade of agents, not the year
items.dz: 自动驾驶从演示到落地用了十几年，Agent 也一样。真正有价值的不是全自动的炫技，是让人能调节自主程度、在关键节点快速验证的「半自动」产品。做这类产品，交互设计和验证效率比模型能力更重要。
items.de: Self-driving took over a decade from demo to deployment, and agents will follow the same arc. The value is not in fully autonomous showpieces but in "partially autonomous" products where people can dial autonomy up or down and verify quickly at key points. For such products, interaction design and verification speed matter more than raw model capability.
items.refLabel: Hamel Husain · Your AI Product Needs Evals

items.zh: To C 看留存，To B 看替换成本
items.en: Consumer AI is about retention, enterprise AI is about switching cost
items.dz: 消费端的 AI 产品，新鲜感过后拼的还是留存：用户愿不愿意每天回来。企业端的关键是替换成本：AI 方案比旧流程好多少，才值得客户承担切换的代价。两边都不是「有 AI」就赢，是「AI 让哪个数字变了」才赢。
items.de: Once novelty fades, consumer AI competes on retention: will people come back every day. On the enterprise side the question is switching cost: how much better than the old process must the AI solution be for a customer to bear the cost of change. Neither side wins by "having AI". They win by "which number AI moved".
